part5.name: Part 5 - Incomplete Sentences
part5.description: Chon tu thich hop de dien vao cho trong trong cau.

questions.text: I need you to finish those reports _______ next Thursday.
questions.explanation: Han chot 'khong muon hon' -> by next Thursday. -> (B)
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc cum 'next Thursday' - can gioi tu chi han chot (deadline). So sanh: by/until/till - cai nao co nghia 'khong muon hon thoi diem do'?

questions.text: Nowadays, _______ households in the developed world have at least one computer.
questions.explanation: Most = phan lon, dung truoc danh tu so nhieu khong co the. -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc danh tu so nhieu 'households' (khong co mao tu). Cac options: most/every/each/much - cai nao hop voi danh tu so nhieu ma khong can mao tu?

questions.text: The company hadn't experienced _______ high call volumes before and were ill-equipped to handle them all.
questions.explanation: Cau truc: such + adj + noun -> such high call volumes. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong + 'high call volumes' -> can xac dinh cau truc: 'so + adj + that' hay 'such + (adj) + noun + that'? Phan biet so va such.

questions.text: The Hoverton Commercial Committee _______ advertising and marketing methods in the region.
questions.explanation: Uy ban quan ly -> regulates (dieu tiet). -> (D)
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'The Hoverton Commercial Committee' -> can dong tu phu hop. Xem xet nghia: uy ban thuong mai lam gi voi 'advertising and marketing methods'?

questions.text: This program is _______ harder to get accustomed to than the old one.
questions.explanation: Very + tinh tu so sanh -> very much harder. O day cac options chi co 'very'. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc tinh tu so sanh 'harder' -> can trung tu bo nghia cho tinh tu so sanh. Cac options nao co the dung truoc comparative adjective?

questions.text: When the manager arrived at the office, she was relieved to see that the technician _______ her computer.
questions.explanation: Menh de chinh qua khu -> hanh dong dang xay ra o thoi diem qua khu -> was fixing. -> (D)
questions.hint: Co hai menh de: 'manager arrived' + 'was relieved to see that...' -> hanh dong 'fix computer' dang xay ra o thoi diem qua khu nao (thì gì)?

questions.text: Many of the product samples brought for demonstration at the convention _______ on the plane ride.
questions.explanation: Chu ngu samples so nhieu, qua khu bi dong -> were lost. -> (D)
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'Many of the product samples' (so nhieu) + cum thoi gian chi qua khu ('on the plane ride') -> can thi gi? Chu y day la bi dong hay chu dong?

questions.text: Even after the terrible fiscal year they had, there was still $1.5 million in _______.
questions.explanation: Sau gioi tu 'in' can danh tu -> profits. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong dung sau gioi tu 'in' -> can danh tu. 4 options: profitably/profitable/profits/profiting - cai nao la danh tu?

questions.text: _______ this problem before, the maintenance technician knew exactly which tool to use to fix the appliance.
questions.explanation: Menh de phan tu hoan thanh: hanh dong xay ra truoc -> Having seen (perfect participle). -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong o dau cau (menh de phan tu). Hanh dong 'thay van de nay' xay ra TRUOC hanh dong 'biet dung cong cu gi'. -> Phan tu hoan thanh hay don gian?

questions.text: In addition to English, the vice-president can fluently _______ in both French and Spanish.
questions.explanation: Converse = tro chuyen; phu hop voi ngu canh noi tieng Phap va Tay Ban Nha. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong dung sau trung tu 'fluently' -> can dong tu nguyen mau. So sanh nghia: convene/convey/converse/convert - cai nao co nghia 'noi chuyen' bang ngon ngu?

questions.text: Though at first glance the products seem very much alike, they are _______ in many ways.
questions.explanation: Tinh tu sau be dong 'are' -> different (khac nhau). -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong dung sau be dong 'are' -> can tinh tu. So sanh 4 options ve tu loai: different/difficult/differed/differentiated.

questions.text: The law firm is looking for a new office building that is neither old _______ located outside of town.
questions.explanation: Cau truc tuong quan: neither ... nor ... -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau truc 'neither... [o trong]...' -> can gi de hoan chinh cau truc tuong quan (correlative conjunction)?

questions.text: Please do not cross the yellow line on the platform _______ the train has come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: Khong duoc qua cho den khi (until) tau dung han. -> (B)
questions.hint: O trong + menh de phu 'the train has come to a complete stop' -> 'khong duoc qua cho den khi' - can lien tu gi?

questions.text: Although Janet and Sam are both excellent managers, there are slight _______ in the way they do their jobs.
questions.explanation: Danh tu chi su khac biet nho: variations. -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong dung sau 'slight' (tinh tu) -> can danh tu. So sanh: variations/varieties/various/varies.

questions.text: _______ business successfully internationally, we must learn the importance of respecting cultural differences.
questions.explanation: Menh de muc dich: To + V (de lam kinh doanh quoc te thanh cong). -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong o dau cau, dung truoc 'business successfully' -> can gi? Menh de muc dich hay menh de dieu kien?

questions.text: If you require further _______, please feel free to contact us at 555-3333.
questions.explanation: Danh tu sau tinh tu 'further' -> information. -> (D)
questions.hint: O trong dung sau 'further' -> can danh tu. Tu loai: informational (adj), informed (adj/v), informative (adj), information (n).

questions.text: It has not rained for weeks, _______ my boss brings an umbrella to work every day.
questions.explanation: Because = vi; giai thich ly do mang o du khong mua. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong ket noi hai menh de: 'It has not rained for weeks' + 'my boss brings an umbrella'. Moi quan he giua 2 y nay la gi?

questions.text: The customer was not satisfied with the service and asked to talk to the manager _______.
questions.explanation: Immediately = ngay lap tuc, phu hop nhat voi nguoi khach buc xuc. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong la trung tu bo nghia cho dong tu 'to talk' (gian tiep). So sanh: instantly/internally/immediately/indirectly - cai nao phu hop voi tinh huong khach hang buc xuc?

questions.text: Most people who are elected to government positions come from _______ families.
questions.explanation: Tinh tu bo nghia danh tu families -> respectable (co uy tin). -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc danh tu 'families' -> can tinh tu. Phan biet: respect (n/v), respecting (v-ing), respectable (adj), respective (adj). Nghia nao phu hop?

questions.text: This is the third time this week that each photocopier _______ broken down.
questions.explanation: Each + danh tu so it -> dong tu so it -> has broken down. -> (B)
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'each photocopier' (so it, xac dinh) + This is the third time... -> can thi gi? Have/has broken down?

questions.text: The electrical wires _______ by the terrible windstorm last night, leaving hundreds of customers without power.
questions.explanation: Moc thoi gian 'last night' + bi dong -> were damaged. -> (B)
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'The electrical wires' (so nhieu) + moc thoi gian 'last night' + bi dong -> can thi va dang gi?

questions.text: This was his fourth time taking his accounting certification exam, and he wanted _______ this time.
questions.explanation: Wanted + to V; phu dinh: to not fail (phu tu not dat truoc dong tu nguyen mau). -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong + dong tu 'fail' -> can cau truc: 'want + [o trong] + to do sth' hay 'want + to + [o trong]'? Vi tri cua 'not' o dau?

questions.text: _______ the research uncovered some problems, the company decided to stop the project.
questions.explanation: Since = vi; ket qua nghien cuu phat hien van de nen cong ty dung du an. -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong o dau cau + menh de 'research uncovered some problems' + ket qua 'company decided to stop'. Moi quan he nhan qua hay nhuong bo?

questions.text: We need greater cooperation from everyone involved in order to meet the _______.
questions.explanation: Meet the deadline = hoan thanh dung han. -> (A)
questions.hint: Cum tu 'meet the _______' -> can danh tu chi moc thoi gian/ket qua can dat. Deadline/termination/boundary/limitations?

questions.text: With just a little more work, he _______ well-prepared for his sales presentation on Friday.
questions.explanation: Su kien tuong lai (Friday) -> will be. -> (A)
questions.hint: Co cum thoi gian 'on Friday' (tuong lai) + 'with just a little more work' -> he was... well-prepared. Thi gi?

questions.text: Every time I need to use the photocopier, I find it needs _______.
questions.explanation: Need + V-ing (bi dong nghia): it needs fixing = can duoc sua. -> (C)
questions.hint: Sau chu ngu 'it' + 'needs' -> can gi? Quy tac: 'need + V-ing' hay 'need + to be + V-pp'? Nghia bi dong.

questions.text: Because of the partnership, Bob and Miles phone _______ several times a day.
questions.explanation: Goi cho nhau = phone each other. -> (C)
questions.hint: Chu ngu 'Bob and Miles phone ___ several times a day' -> hai nguoi goi cho nhau. O trong la gi?

questions.text: Let's take another _______ at the sales figures.
questions.explanation: Take a glance at = nhin qua/xem qua (nhanh). -> (C)
questions.hint: Cum 'take another ___ at' -> can danh tu chi hanh dong nhin/kiem tra nhanh. View/scene/glance/vision?

questions.text: It is reported that the boat _______ about 60 miles off the coast of South Africa last week.
questions.explanation: Disappear la noi dong tu (khong co bi dong); qua khu don -> disappeared. -> (A)
questions.hint: Dong tu 'disappear' la noi dong tu (intransitive) -> co the dung bi dong khong? Moc thoi gian 'last week'.

questions.text: Since this is our slow season, I am considering _______ to vacation next month.
questions.explanation: Consider + V-ing -> considering going. -> (B)
questions.hint: Dong tu 'considering' + o trong -> considering + gi? V-ing hay to V?

part6.name: Part 6 - Text Completion
part6.description: Doc doan van va dien tu thich hop vao cho trong.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 1: Independent Television Broadcasting Letter (Cau 131-134)
questions.text: We want to thank you for your recent e-mail _______ last week's airing of our documentary on Moroccan street markets. We are glad that you enjoyed it and plan to watch our series more. We looked into your claim of an error in translation during one of the interviews of the street vendors...
questions.explanation: Regarding + cum danh tu = ve viec; phan tu chi y nghia. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong dung sau 'e-mail' truoc cum 'last week's airing' -> can phan tu/gioi tu gi de ket noi 'thu dien tu VE viec phat song'?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 1: Independent Television Broadcasting Letter (Cau 131-134)
questions.text: He currently _______ to correct this, and the documentary will be uploaded online with the correct translation.
questions.explanation: Hanh dong dang dien ra hien tai -> is working. -> (B)
questions.hint: O trong ket noi 2 menh de: 'He currently ___ to correct this, and the documentary will be uploaded'. Hanh dong dang dien ra hien tai -> thi gi?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 1: Independent Television Broadcasting Letter (Cau 131-134)
questions.text: [133]. As such, we will be sending you a station tote bag along with a water bottle. Please accept these gifts of our gratitude.
options: (C) We appreciate your help in fixing this error.
questions.explanation: Cau [133] phai ket noi y tu biet on viec sua loi dich sang gui qua -> We appreciate your help in fixing this error. -> (C)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: Cau [133] dung truoc 'As such, we will be sending you a station tote bag'. Cau nao ket noi tu nhien voi viec gui qua bieu?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 1: Independent Television Broadcasting Letter (Cau 131-134)
questions.text: Please accept these gifts of our _______. It is viewers like you that inspire us to work harder and put forth better programs.
questions.explanation: Gifts of our gratitude = qua bieu to long biet on. Danh tu: gratitude. -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong sau 'gifts of our' -> can danh tu chi cam xuc/tinh cam. Gratitude/gratification/gratis/gratifying - cai nao la danh tu?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: _______ the weeklong carnival, the town of Whitby held various competitions, from raffles to trivia contests.
questions.explanation: During + danh tu: trong suot le hoi. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong + 'the weeklong carnival' (danh tu) + menh de chinh. Can gioi tu/lien tu nao de biet y 'trong suot le hoi'?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: _______ resident of Whitby was automatically entered into the main raffle contest.
questions.explanation: Each + danh tu so it: each resident. -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong + 'resident' (so it) -> can tu xac dinh phu hop voi danh tu so it. Phan biet: each/most/almost/all voi danh tu so it.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: [137]. But we also want to take a moment to mention a special winner. Ms. Higgins has won the award four years in a row for her dedication to the town and weekly volunteer work at the town's various community centers.
options: (A) We were surprised by the results.
(B) The carnival is open from 9 to 5.
(C) We would like to congratulate all of our winners.
(D) If you do not accept your award, it will be given to the runner-up.
questions.explanation: Cau [137] giai thieu truoc khi neu cac nguoi thang giai -> We would like to congratulate all of our winners. -> (C)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: Cau [137] dung truoc 'But we also want to take a moment to mention a special winner'. Cau nao la cau chuyen tiep tu nhien truoc khi neu ten nguoi thang dac biet?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Whitby Annual Carnival Raffle Winners (Cau 135-138)
questions.text: All winners will receive a $100 gift voucher from Whitby Supermarket. _______ your prize, please call the Town Hall Social Services office at 555-8389.
questions.explanation: Menh de muc dich: To claim your prize (de nhan phan thuong). -> (D)
questions.hint: O trong + 'your prize' + 'please call' -> can cau truc gi de biet y 'de nhan phan thuong'? Menh de muc dich hay menh de tiep dien?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala Email (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: It is with great _______ that we invite you to the Read for the Future Charity Gala at the Hillside Manor.
questions.explanation: It is with great pleasure = tran trong duoc moi -> cum co dinh. -> (C)
questions.hint: Cum 'It is with great ___' -> day la cum co dinh trong van viet trang trong. Danh tu nao phu hop nhat?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala Email (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: dress is formal attire. . The proceeds from this will go toward the library expansion project. , Please send the RSVP by January 15". If you are unable to attend, you will be sorely missed. However, you are still able to make a donation through our special donor website at www.readfuture.org. We look forward to having an evening with you.
questions.explanation: Su kien chua dien ra (tuong lai) -> will feature. -> (A)
questions.hint: O trong + 'live entertainment and a three-course meal' -> su kien nay LA GI / SE CO gi. Thi gi phu hop cho su kien tuong lai?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala Email (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: Dress is formal attire. _______. The proceeds from this will go toward the library expansion project.
options: (A) We ask that each person who attends the dinner give a donation of $50 or more to the organization.
(B) Families with children under the age of 10 are asked to leave their children at home.
(C) Those with special dietary restrictions are asked to mention their preference on their RSVP.
(D) Dinner will be held in the outdoor terrace beginning at 8 p.m.
questions.explanation: Sau trang phuc, can thong tin ve dia diem/thoi gian an toi -> Dinner will be held at outdoor terrace at 8 pm. -> (D)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: Cau [141] dung sau 'Dress is formal attire.' va truoc 'The proceeds from this will go toward the library expansion project.' Can cau nao ket noi tu nhien?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Read for the Future Charity Gala Email (Cau 139-142)
questions.text: (A) (B) (C) (D) ae a eee eee Fees ieee the organization. Families with children under the age of 10 are asked to leave their children at home. Those with special dietary restrictions are asked to mention their preference on their RSVP. Dinner will be held in the outdoor terrace beginning at 8 p.m. unfortunate ecstatic unforgettable optimistic
questions.explanation: Mot buoi toi dang nho / khong the quen -> unforgettable. -> (C)
questions.hint: O trong + 'evening' -> can tinh tu bo nghia cho buoi toi trong thu moi du tiec. Tinh tu nao phu hop nhat voi buc thu trang trong lich su?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.explanation: Tinh tu so huu truoc danh tu customers -> our customers (cua chung toi). -> (D)
questions.hint: O trong dung truoc 'customers' -> can tu so huu phu hop voi chuoi cua hang dang quang cao. Our/your/ours/yours - cai nao la tinh tu so huu?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: (A) (B) (c) (D) yours ours your our none not no nothing
options: (A) The more you buy, the more you save,
(D) Please see the manager to sign up for
questions.explanation: Not valid = khong hop le (theo ngu canh: uong dau chu y - khong ap dung cho nhan hieu Banone). -> (B)
questions.hint: O trong + 'valid for the Banone brand' -> cau nay noi rang uu dai nay '[o trong] co hieu luc voi nhan hieu Banone'. Phu dinh hay khang dinh?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: everything you need to feed your family without breaking the bank. Offers valid June 2” to 9", . Due to conditions beyond our control, items advertised may
questions.explanation: Much + tinh tu so sanh hon (better) = tot hon han. -> (B)
questions.hint: O trong + 'better' (tinh tu so sanh) -> can trung tu bo nghia truoc tinh tu so sanh. Cai nao trong 4 options co the dung truoc comparative?

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 4: Super Savers Weekly Specials (Cau 143-146)
questions.text: not be available, As a result, rain checks are not available,
options: (A) The more you buy, the more you save.
(C) Selections may vary from store to store.
(D) Please see the manager to sign up for our membership program.
questions.explanation: Cau [146] giai thich truoc thong tin 'items may not be available' -> Selections may vary from store to store. -> (C)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: Cau [146] dung truoc 'Due to conditions beyond our control, items advertised may not be available.' Can cau nao giai thich/dan dat tu nhien?

part7.name: Part 7 - Reading Comprehension
part7.description: Doc cac doan van va tra loi cau hoi lien quan.

questions.text: What is NOT stated about the retiring CEO?
options: (A) He will remain on the board of directors.
(B) He has held several jobs at the company.
(C) He has been with Ventura for 20 years.
(D) He focused on creating new products as CEO.
questions.explanation: Lucas duoc bau vao HDQT tu 2004, lam CEO 2009. Garza moi la nguoi 20 nam. -> (C) la sai ve Lucas.
questions.hint: Cau hoi NOT -> 3 dap an DUNG = nhung dieu DUNG ve retiring CEO. Loai tung dap an bang cach scan passage tim thong tin ve Lucas.

questions.text: The word “effective” in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Effective October 31 = co hieu luc tu ngay 31/10 -> operative (bat dau co hieu luc). -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi tu vung 'effective' -> doc cau co chua tu nay. Ngu canh: 'effective on October 31' -> tu 'effective' o day co nghia gi?

questions.text: What is suggested about Ellen B?
options: (A) She is willing to miss the CFO visit.
(C) She did not receive an e-mail.
questions.explanation: Ellen muon di an Thai vi 'lots of vegetarian options for you, too' -> khong an thit. -> (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi SUGGESTED -> suy luan tu dieu Meryl noi ('lots of vegetarian options for you, too'). Dieu gi duoc ngam hieu ve Ellen?

questions.text: At 11:48, what does Ellen B mean when she writes, “Thai food it is, then”?
options: (A) She wants to try the restaurant another time.
(B) She will go to the restaurant for lunch.
(C) She wants to know more about Thai food.
questions.explanation: Thai food it is = duoc roi, chon Thai food; se di an Thai. -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: 'Thai food it is, then' co nghia gi? Day la cau khang dinh quyet dinh hay tu choi?

questions.text: How much has Vista Hotel already paid?
questions.explanation: Payments: -2,000.00 -> da thanh toan $2,000. -> (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: 'How much has Vista Hotel already paid?' -> scan invoice tim muc 'Payments'. So lieu nao la so da thanh toan?

questions.text: Which is true about Mint Design?
options: (B) It charges a set price per project.
(C) It coes not specify a payment method.
(D) It does not charge late fees.
questions.explanation: Design services: $3,500 per project -> gia co dinh theo du an. -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: Which is TRUE -> doi chieu tung option voi thong tin trong invoice. 'It charges a set price per project' -> kiem tra bang gia.

questions.text: Why is Randy selling his car? f
questions.explanation: 'my company is transferring me overseas' -> chuyen di nuoc ngoai. -> (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHY is Randy selling? -> Scan quang cao tim ly do. 'company is transferring me...' co nghia gi?

questions.text: What is stated about the car?
options: (D) It has a new coat of paint.
questions.explanation: Classic F-platform with original doors and GM/Delco stereo -> con am thanh goc. -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What is STATED -> scan qua tung option va doi chieu. Option B: 'original stereo' - co trong quang cao khong?

questions.text: Where is Mr. Brown now?
questions.explanation: 'I will now be leaving Concord early tomorrow morning' -> hien tai van o Concord. -> (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHERE is Mr. Brown NOW? -> He is LEAVING Concord 'tomorrow morning' -> ngay hom nay ong ay o dau?

questions.text: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "My flight to California has been canceled because of bad weather.”
questions.explanation: Cau giai thich ly do chuyen bay bi huy -> dung o [1] truoc khi giai thich lich bay moi. -> (A)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: 'My flight to California has been canceled because of bad weather.' -> Cau nay giai thich ly do tai sao. Vi tri nao can giai thich truoc khi neu lich bay moi?

questions.text: When will Mr. Brown arrive?
questions.explanation: 'reschedule our meetings for the day after I get there, the 17th' -> den noi ngay 17/8. -> (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHEN will Mr. Brown arrive? -> Tim ngay cu the trong email. 'the day after I get there, the 17th' -> ngay 17 la ngay nao?

questions.text: On what day are two movies shown?
questions.explanation: Elvis and the Swamp Monster: Thursday and Friday; Digstown: Friday through Sunday -> Friday co 2 phim. -> (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: On what day are TWO movies shown? -> Kiem tra lich chieu tung phim. Ngay nao co 2 phim cung chieu?

questions.text: How will the theater choose the theme of the next special feature week?
questions.explanation: 'fill in an audience choice form... We will select our next genre based on the results of the survey' -> hoi khan gia. -> (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: HOW will theater choose next theme? -> Scan van ban tim thong tin ve audience/survey.

questions.text: What is the latest time that one can see a movie?
questions.explanation: Digstown: Friday through Sunday, 9:00 p.m., 12.00 a.m. -> suat chieu muon nhat la nua dem. -> (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What is the LATEST time? -> Kiem tra tat ca suat chieu, tim suat muon nhat trong ngay.

questions.text: What does Linda Trent request?
questions.explanation: 'I would appreciate receiving the information by e-mail' -> yeu cau tra loi qua email. -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What does Linda REQUEST? -> Tim dong tu/menh de chi yeu cau trong thu. 'I would appreciate receiving...'

questions.text: What is Linda Trent's opinion of Galoob Ceramics?
options: (C) Their products used to be better.
questions.explanation: 'I was amazed yet again at the variety and creativity... vases and bowls are quite exquisite!' -> rat an tuong. -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What is Linda's OPINION? -> Tim cac tu/cau the hien cam nhan tich cuc hay tieu cuc.

questions.text: What will the coffee shop use to hold sugar?
questions.explanation: 'I will probably purchase 50 or more of the ladybug bowls. They are perfect for holding sugar cubes.' -> ladybug bowls. -> (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What will coffee shop USE to hold sugar? -> Scan thu tim thong tin ve ladybug bowls.

questions.text: What does Sam Kliff apologize for?
options: (C) Texting his coworkers on the weekend
questions.explanation: Sam: 'Sorry to bother you on a Saturday' -> xin loi vi nhan tin vao cuoi tuan. -> (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What does Sam APOLOGIZE for? -> Tim cau 'Sorry' trong doan chat. Ong ay xin loi vi dieu gi cu the?

questions.text: What is suggested about Peter?
options: (A) He is new to the company.
questions.explanation: Tina: 'he almost never takes a day off' -> lam ca ngay nghi. -> (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: What is SUGGESTED about Peter? -> Tim thong tin gian tiep ve Peter qua loi nhan xet cua Tina.

questions.text: What will Rob Martin most likely do next?
questions.explanation: Rob: 'I'll call him' (Peter) -> se goi cho Peter. -> (A)
